name: Lead Conversion Journey
description: The source → playbook funnel: ONE shared conversion arc (new → contacted → engaged → qualified → handoff) with per-source overlays that tailor the FIRST-TOUCH stages to how the lead came in. Overlays layer ADDITIVELY onto a single abstract base (`conversion-base`) via `extends`, so the shared middle/late stages live in exactly one place. Materializes four concrete session-template playbooks: a generic fallback plus cold-outreach / inbound / referral variants. The `lead-conversion-enrollment` capability automation (separate seed) routes a newly-created lead to the matching playbook by its `source` and starts a session on it (idempotent per lead). STARTER CONTENT — the stage goals and suggested tasks are sensible defaults for an agency funnel; tailor them to your own process. Applied via createLoopFromDefinition (templateKey "lead-conversion"); base+overlay flatten through resolveComposedPlaybooks at apply time.

basePlaybooks.name: Conversion Journey (base)
basePlaybooks.goalTemplate: Move this lead through the conversion journey — from first touch to a signed client — and log every step.
basePlaybooks.description: Abstract shared conversion arc. Never materialized on its own; per-source overlays extend it. STARTER — edit the stages to match your funnel.

stages.name: New
stages.goal: Triage the new lead: confirm it is a real fit and decide the first move.
suggestedTasks: Review the lead's source and any captured context.
Confirm contact details and decide the first outreach channel.

stages.name: Contacted
stages.goal: Make first contact and earn a reply.
suggestedTasks: Send the first message or make the first call.
Log the response, or set a follow-up if they are silent.

stages.name: Engaged
stages.goal: Understand what they need and whether we can help.
suggestedTasks: Ask about their goals, timeline, and budget.
Capture notes on fit and any objections.

stages.name: Qualified
stages.goal: Confirm this is a real opportunity worth a proposal.
suggestedTasks: Confirm decision-maker, budget, and timeline.
Draft the proposal or scope of work.

stages.name: Hand-off
stages.goal: Convert to a client and hand off to delivery.
suggestedTasks: Create the deal or client record.
Schedule the kickoff and introduce the delivery owner.

playbooks.name: Conversion — Standard
playbooks.goalTemplate: Move this lead through the standard conversion journey — from first touch to a signed client.
playbooks.description: Fallback conversion journey for sources without a tailored playbook (e.g. twitter, event, other). Pure base arc.

playbooks.name: Conversion — Cold Outreach
playbooks.goalTemplate: Convert a cold lead: research, personalize, run an outreach sequence, then move them through the journey.
playbooks.description: Outbound first-touch overlay (cold-outreach / linkedin). Refines the early stages for a no-prior-relationship lead. STARTER — tailor the outreach cadence to your team.

stages.name: Research & target
stages.goal: Research the prospect and build a real reason to reach out — this is a cold lead with no prior relationship.
suggestedTasks: Research the prospect's company, role, and recent activity.
Write a personalized angle for the first touch — no generic templates.

stages.name: Outreach sequence
stages.goal: Run a multi-touch outreach sequence until they respond.
suggestedTasks: Send the first personalized message on the chosen channel.
Queue 2-3 spaced follow-ups; stop the moment they reply.

playbooks.name: Conversion — Inbound
playbooks.goalTemplate: Convert a warm inbound lead: respond fast, qualify while intent is hot, then move them through the journey.
playbooks.description: Warm inbound overlay (landing-page / inbound-call). Speed-to-lead: acknowledge fast and qualify quickly. STARTER — set your own response-time target.

stages.name: Acknowledge fast
stages.goal: Respond FAST — an inbound lead expects a reply within minutes, not days.
suggestedTasks: Acknowledge the inbound within the hour.
Pull any context they submitted (form fields, call notes).

stages.name: Fast qualify
stages.goal: Qualify quickly while intent is hot.
suggestedTasks: Confirm what they are looking for and their timeline.
Book the next call before the thread goes cold.

playbooks.name: Conversion — Referral
playbooks.goalTemplate: Convert a referred lead: thank the referrer, lean on the warm intro, then move them through the journey.
playbooks.description: Warm-intro overlay (referral). Uses the existing trust from the referrer. STARTER — adapt to how you handle intros.

stages.name: Thank the referrer
stages.goal: Acknowledge the warm intro and thank whoever referred them.
suggestedTasks: Thank the referrer and confirm you will follow up.
Reference the mutual connection in your first message to the lead.

stages.name: Warm follow-up
stages.goal: Lean on the warm intro — this lead already has a reason to trust you.
suggestedTasks: Reach out referencing the shared context.
Move quickly to a call; warm leads convert fast.
